claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: GW-9662 is a PPARgamma antagonist with no intrinsic cytotoxic pharmacophore; at 2.5 uM over 5 days it is expected to be largely inactive, with any weak antiproliferative effect reflecting non-specific lipophilicity rather than a defined killing mechanism.
